_what_this_is: A FETCHED snapshot of the live Devpost submission form, not a design of it. The generator builds the answer table from this file and a test asserts every required field appears in docs/SUBMISSION.md, so a required field cannot go missing the way two of them already had. Same split as the deployment probe: the networked half writes the record, the offline half asserts against it.
_how_to_refresh: Re-read the form through the Devpost MCP (get_submission_requirements) and rewrite this file. Do not edit a field by hand: a hand-written line in a fetched record is the one line nothing checks.
_option_lists: Options are recorded only where the set is small enough to be a real constraint. The country dropdown has 200-odd entries and its count is recorded instead, because a list that long is not something a guard can meaningfully compare.
